name: exec_preflight_guard
description: Runs a local preflight command and lets the model's risk verdict decide whether to proceed. exec is opt-in and host/time/output-bounded.

is_risky.instructions: Given that this is a destructive-looking operation on the target path, is it risky to proceed?

criteria.A: no, it is a safe operation on this path
criteria.B: yes, it could destroy or corrupt important state
